priors.baseline_mean_seconds: Normal(.6,.4), independently for each matched baseline pool
priors.corrected_intercept_seconds: four fixed coefficients Normal(0,.2), independent participant coefficient SDs HalfNormal(.12)
priors.signed_amplitude_seconds: four fixed coefficients Normal(0,.15), independent participant coefficient SDs HalfNormal(.15)
priors.midpoint_normalized: fixed intercept Normal(.5,.5*s), other fixed coefficients Normal(0,.5*s); random coefficient SDs HalfNormal(.35*s)
priors.log_width_normalized: fixed intercept Normal(log(1/6),.7*s), other fixed coefficients Normal(0,.7*s); random coefficient SDs HalfNormal(.5*s)
priors.sigma_seconds: independent by participant and trial type, LogNormal(log(.12),.5)
priors.coding: Condition and Phase ±.5; interaction product; all random coefficients independent conditional on SDs
